title: Chapter whereby one liveth by the breath of air in the Netherworld

verses.t: Chapter whereby one liveth by the breath of air in the Netherworld, and keepeth back Merta.
I am the god in Lion form; the heir of Râ and Tmu in Chemmis, the Master in their halls.
Those who are in their cells accompany me as guides. I have made my way and gone round the heavenly Ocean on the path of the Bark of Râ, and standing on the girders of the Bark of Râ.
I utter his words to the men of the present generation and I repeat his words to him who is deprived of breath.
I spy out for my father Râ at sunset, compressing my mouth, and feeding upon life.
I live in Tattu, and I repeat my life after death like the Sun daily.
